channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Bass | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Bass from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Brandon Bass
item.description:
“I am excited to add a player of Brandon’s skill level and character to our roster,”

Mitch Kupchak on Brandon Bass, Jul 9, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tony Dutt on Brandon Bass
item.description:
Dutt added that Bass would be open to a return to the Celtics.

“I think Brad [Stevens] and Danny [Ainge] understand the value of what Brandon brings,”

Tony Dutt on Brandon Bass, Jun 30, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Brandon Bass
item.description:
In an interview with CSNNE.com prior to last week’s trade deadline, Ainge alluded to Bass’ future being beyond this season in Boston.

“Brandon may be with us next year and the year after that as well,”

Danny Ainge on Brandon Bass, Feb 23, 2015. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Brandon Bass
item.description:
“What I like about Brandon, he just … he’s never satisfied with his role. He goes about his job the same, every day. He’s a rare guy in that he’s getting better. I think he’s better right now than he’s ever been in his career. And I think his upside is still ahead of him.”

Danny Ainge on Brandon Bass, Feb 23, 2015. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Brandon Bass
item.description:
Rajon Rondo:

“It happens so often in this league. It starts in training camp when you have to say goodbye to the guys that get cut. You are attached to them for a few weeks and they get cut. I’ve been here for a long time. I’ve been friends with Jeff, Brandon and Avery for five years now. We still keep in touch. No one has died. We still have the same phone numbers and we keep in touch.”

Rajon Rondo on Brandon Bass, Jan 2, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Rajon Rondo, Brandon Bass, Jeff Green
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“I think Boston's going to be fine. That team has always been proven, they always succeed, always push the envelope when it comes to winning, and they have good pieces up there-- Jeff Green, Rajon (Rondo), Brandon Bass, guys up there that's really hard-working guys, that will come in and compete every night, are going to put forth a valid effort. So they're not going to be shabby, not at all.”

Kevin Garnett on Rajon Rondo, Brandon Bass, Jeff Green, Sep 10, 2013. Source: Booth Newspapers.
